note: 26 hook formulas for Reels. Each formula carries a match regex for automatic classification.
rules: Write the spoken line and the on-screen line separately
No setup - video starts at the payoff
Say the number - 'a lot' is not a number
First frame is a hook too - need motion or text

hooks.name: Cost Confession
hooks.example: $18,000 is what one missing clause cost me

hooks.name: Negative Command
hooks.example: Stop posting three times a day. Post twice instead

hooks.name: Nobody Tells You
hooks.example: Nobody tells you that your first 30 reels are supposed to flop

hooks.name: The Replacement
hooks.example: This $12 tool replaced my $2,000/month editor

hooks.name: Time Collapse
hooks.example: Proposals used to take 5 hours. Now 20 minutes

hooks.name: The Receipt
hooks.example: I posted one reel a day for 60 days. Here are the numbers

hooks.name: Wrong Way, Right Way
hooks.example: You are writing captions wrong, and it is not your fault

hooks.name: Insider Leak
hooks.example: I spent 6 years selling agency retainers. Here is what we never said

hooks.name: The Steal
hooks.example: Steal this four-line follow-up. It took 2 years

hooks.name: If This, Then Watch
hooks.example: If your reels get views and no followers, the next 40s fixes it

hooks.name: Numbered With A Favourite
hooks.example: Five caption edits that double saves. Number four is the one nobody does

hooks.name: The Objection
hooks.example: "I don't want to be on camera." Fine. Here is the faceless version

hooks.name: Before And After, On Screen
hooks.example: This was my profile in March. This is it now

hooks.name: The Callout
hooks.example: Photographers charging under $2,000: this is the pricing page you avoid

hooks.name: The Flop Record
hooks.example: My first 47 reels averaged 300 views. Number 48 did 400,000

hooks.name: The Verbatim Question

hooks.name: Head To Head

hooks.name: The Deadline

hooks.name: Permission

hooks.name: Mid-Sentence Start
hooks.example: ...and that is when the client asked for refund

hooks.name: Contrarian Flip
hooks.example: Nice guys finish first

hooks.name: The Reveal
